Fikry, B. A. Shapiro’s The Art Forger, and Robert Goolrick’s A Reliable Wife—and nonfiction, including Amy Stewart’s The Drunken Botanist and Richard Louv’s Last Child in the Woods. In 2013, Algonquin launched the Algonquin Young Readers imprint featuring middle grade and young adult books.

Acquired by Workman Publishing in 1989 and then by Hachette Book Group in 2021, Algonquin Books has held true to its founding principles to publish quality narrative work that stimulates, enriches, and entertains readers.
